title: Sylow cover with an exact associated-sheaf functor
statement: Let ℓ be prime, U an irreducible scheme, and G a finite locally constant sheaf of ULift(ℤ/ℓℤ)-modules on the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There is a connected finite étale cover v:V→U [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-connected-scheme] of constant geometric-fibre cardinality d [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre] with ℓ∤d. There are a finite ℓ-group P, a finite-dimensional representation M of P over ℤ/ℓℤ, and an additive functor T from all ℤ/ℓℤ-representations of P to sheaves of ULift(ℤ/ℓℤ)-modules on V, preserving finite limits and colimits, such that T(M) is isomorphic to v*G [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and T of the trivial rank-one representation ULift(ℤ/ℓℤ) is the constant coefficient sheaf. A representation means a vector space with a group homomorphism P→End(M) giving a linear group action; morphisms are equivariant linear maps. No filtration is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 0A3R (lemma-pullback-filtered), statement and proof; Lemma 0DV5 (lemma-locally-constant-on-connected); Remark 0DV6 (remark-functorial-locally-constant-on-connected)

proof.text: Choose a geometric point of the nonempty connected irreducible scheme U. Under the finite monodromy correspondence G is a finite-dimensional ZMod ℓ-module. Its finite image Q acts faithfully. Choose an ℓ-Sylow subgroup P; its index d is prime to ℓ. Replace P by an isomorphic finite group in Type u if necessary. The connected Galois Q-cover Y determines the connected cover V=Y/P. Functoriality identifies the pulled-back sheaf with the restriction M of the representation to P.

source.place: Lemma 0A3R (lemma-pullback-filtered), statement and proof; Lemma 0DV5 (lemma-locally-constant-on-connected); Remark 0DV6 (remark-functorial-locally-constant-on-connected)

proof.text: The cover is finite étale, hence finite locally free. Its degree is locally constant on connected U and invariant under residue-field extension. Over a separably closed geometric point its algebra splits into copies of the field, whose number is both its degree and the number of geometric lifts. At the chosen point this number is [Q:P]=d, hence all the geometric fibres have cardinality d.

source.place: Lemma 0A3R (lemma-pullback-filtered), statement and proof; Lemma 0DV5 (lemma-locally-constant-on-connected); Remark 0DV6 (remark-functorial-locally-constant-on-connected)

proof.text: The finite étale P-torsor Y over V defines an associated-sheaf functor T on P-representations. Concretely glue the constant module sheaf on étale trivializations of Y using the transition P-actions. The cocycle identity is the group-action identity, and equivariant linear maps commute with the gluing. Transport scalars through ZMod ℓ ≃ ULift (ZMod ℓ). This construction applies to infinite modules too, since a finite P-action is discrete and continuous. On every geometric stalk T is the underlying-module functor followed by this scalar equivalence. It is additive and exact by exactness and conservativity of geometric stalks, hence preserves finite limits and colimits. The trivial rank-one representation glues with identity transition maps, giving the constant coefficient sheaf; the monodromy of v*G identifies T(M) with v*G. No invariant flag is constructed here.

theorem Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.exists_sylow_cover_associated_sheaf
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace U] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] :
    ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ U) (_ : IsFinite v) (_ : Etale v) (_ : ConnectedSpace V)
      (d : ℕ), ¬ ℓ ∣ d ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U),
        Nat.card (v.GeometricFiber s) = d) ∧
      ∃ (P : Type u) (_ : Group P) (_ : Finite P), IsPGroup ℓ P ∧
        ∃ (M : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (_ : FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) M.V)
          (T : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P ⥤
            Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
          (_ : T.Additive) (_ : PreservesFiniteLimits T) (_ : PreservesFiniteColimits T),
          Nonempty (T.obj M ≅ (v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj G) ∧
          Nonempty (T.obj (Rep.trivial (ZMod ℓ) P (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ≅
            (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj
              (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
